title: SafeFailure
description: What went wrong, in terms both sides already agreed on. No stack, no raw error, no provider response: a failure crosses a trust boundary, and whatever it carries is the part an attacker gets to read.

code.description: A closed vocabulary. Anything unrecognised is not a code.

retryable.description: Whether another attempt could reach a different answer.

detail.description: Optional bounded text written by the Control Plane for an operator. Omit it rather than sending null; never copy a provider message into it.
